name: com.huawei.android.hms.agent.common.HMSAgentActivity
description: Huawei’s HMS Agent opens this Activity when an HMS connection error needs user attention, shows Huawei’s repair flow, and returns the result to the agent.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete Huawei’s connection-repair flow, so Huawei services that need the repair, including push, may remain unavailable.
